title: Sector-specific CII categorization overlay for communications

lifecycle.basis: Resolution clause 2 expressly states both dates

governance_rules.rule: Defines the sector-specific correspondence and calculation layer used to assign a significance category to a communications-sector CII object.
Sector significance sign is the number of subscribers, including legal-entity communications-service users, served through the object.

commission_and_assessment_rules.rule: The subject head establishes a permanent commission under PP 127; specified MinTsifry or Roskomnadzor representatives are included for the listed subordinate entities and universal-service operators only by agreement with the relevant authority.

indicator_routing_rules.rule: Indicators outside clause 8 are considered only in the case provided by PP 127 clause 14^2; this is not a blanket route.

input_and_method_rules.rule: Assign the object category by the highest applicable indicator value obtained with the clause 11 methods.

calculation_rules.rule: Count subscribers, including legal entities, with communications-service contracts; when one object supports several services, calculate each service separately and assign by the aggregate of those values.
Calculate by the level and number of listed public bodies or organizations for which communications services may be disrupted or unavailable.
Assess probability that a listed public body or statutory organization cannot perform its function because the object-supported process cannot be realized.

calculation_rules.D_actual: Income including VAT, excise and other mandatory payments for the assessed period
calculation_rules.D_average: Annual income averaged over the preceding five-year period

calculation_rules.Delta_payments: Reduction of the subject's payments to budgets of the Russian budget system
calculation_rules.B_average: Forecast annual federal-budget income averaged over the planned three-year period

rules: Derive B_average under the federal budget law and other Russian legislation
Derive annual taxes from Federal Tax Service data and fully account for the listed incident-response, downtime, overtime and contract-penalty costs
Determine the maximum possible communications-service interruption period and maximum possible profit reduction for that period

guardrails: As of 2026-08-19 this act is adopted but not yet in force; do not present it as currently operative before 2026-09-01.
The act ceases to operate at 2026-09-01; preserve this lifecycle boundary.
Commission representatives in clause 5 apply only to the listed subject classes and require agreement with the named authority.
Do not apply positions 4(b), 6 or 8 outside their clause 8 subject conditions.
Clause 9 does not make every unlisted indicator automatically applicable.
For position 4(a), separate per-service calculations and their aggregate must both be preserved.
The five-year periods in clauses 16-17 are calculation and fallback-data lookbacks, not evidence-retention duties.
The 10-day value in clause 17 is a calculation fallback for remediation time, not a remediation SLA or incident-reporting deadline.
The three-year period for B_average is planned, not historical.
No category is proven until applicable PP 127 thresholds are compared against complete object facts.
